about.title: About NDS-Shop
about.description: NDS-Shop is your go-to platform for Nintendo DS games, regularly updated with new releases and easy-to-access downloads.
about.project_description: NDS-Shop is an open-source project developed by a community of video game enthusiasts. Our goal is to provide a user-friendly and accessible platform for Nintendo DS fans, offering a wide selection of games for easy downloading. We believe in the power of community and encourage contributions to continuously improve the site and expand our game catalog.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Simple, clear, and transparent for NDS-Shop
privacy.dataCollectionText: NDS-Shop does not collect any personal data from its users. We respect your privacy and do not use tracking cookies.
dataCollectionItems: No information is shared with third parties
Important: We are not subject to GDPR or CCPA, but choose not to collect data as a principle
privacy.technicalText: When accessing our services, your browser may temporarily process some technical information:
technicalItems: Temporary cache files (managed by the browser)
privacy.thirdPartyText: NDS-Shop uses third-party services to ensure site performance and security:
privacy.securityText: We do not collect personal data, but maintain robust security measures to protect our infrastructure:
privacy.contactText: For privacy-related inquiries, contact us at: privacy@nds-shop.com. We respond to inquiries but are not obliged to delete data we do not collect.
privacy.updatesText: This policy may be updated at any time without prior notice. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. Last updated: September 2025
